description: This file defines the StopDefault enum and associated functions for handling residual formulas and their default stopping conditions in a temporal logic context.

classes.name: StopDefault
classes.description: An enum representing default stopping conditions, with variants True and False(Violation<Function>)

methods.name: stop_default
methods.description: Determines the default stopping condition based on a residual formula and a time.

methods.name: stop_and_default
methods.description: Combines two StopDefault values with logical AND semantics.

methods.name: stop_or_default
methods.description: Combines two StopDefault values with logical OR semantics.

methods.name: stop_implies_default
methods.description: Determines default stopping condition for an implication between formulas.

methods.name: stop_and_always_default
methods.description: Handles default stopping condition for 'and always' temporal operator.

methods.name: stop_or_eventually_default
methods.description: Handles default stopping condition for 'or eventually' temporal operator.
